answer: Yes, you can sell it at a North Carolina store. We buy cars registered in any state we serve, even if you now live somewhere else. You'll need to take care of two things first. Normally an expired registration is fine and doesn't change the offer, but North Carolina is the exception: the registration has to be current on the day of the sale, so renew your Virginia registration before your appointment. Also, because the car is registered in another state, you'll need an emissions certificate from a North Carolina inspection station before a North Carolina store can buy it. Bring the Virginia registration. Your Virginia plates are yours to remove and keep. The help center doesn't explain how to renew a Virginia registration, so please contact a store or Virginia's motor vehicle agency for help with that.
